mapper.select: SELECT link.option_value_id FROM sku_option_values link JOIN product_option_values value ON value.id = link.option_value_id JOIN product_options option_item ON option_item.id = value.option_id WHERE link.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY option_item.sort_order, option_item.id

SELECT link.sku_id AS skuId, link.option_value_id AS valueId, value.value_name AS valueName FROM sku_option_values link JOIN product_option_values value ON value.id = link.option_value_id JOIN product_options option_item ON option_item.id = value.option_id WHERE link.sku_id IN #{skuId} ORDER BY link.sku_id, option_item.sort_order, option_item.id
